expectedResults: List and inspect commands expose planned catalog information using existing Conch conventions.
Default conversion output contains the converted value and target unit without dimension metadata.
The explicit metadata option adds the converted value's dimension to output.
Unknown units, incompatible dimensions, and invalid options produce clear deterministic errors.
notes: System Engineer planning decision: dimension metadata is opt-in for conversion output and is omitted by default.
objective: Verify Conch unit listing, metadata inspection, and conversion commands use Caliper APIs and follow existing command conventions.
steps: List available units and inspect a representative unit.
Convert values between compatible units with default output.
Repeat a conversion with the explicit option that adds dimension metadata to output.
Attempt conversion with an unknown unit, incompatible dimensions, and an invalid option.
title: Conch Caliper inspection and conversion commands
